<div class="box2 row1-1 first"> <a class="image-fade" href="WhoWeAre.aspx"> <img alt="Dubli-Who-We-Are" src="/Images/Home/earth1.jpg"/> </a> <div class="inner"> <h1>Who we are</h1> <p>Founded in 2003, Dubli Network is a global marketing company that offers people from all walks of life the opportunity to build a career or second-income business by generating earnings from the millions of...</p> <a href="WhoWeAre.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div> <a class="carousel-control left" data-slide="prev" href="#carousel"> <span class="dart"></span> <span class="trunc">Previous Slide</span> </a> <a class="carousel-control right" data-slide="next" href="#carousel"> <span class="dart"></span> <span class="trunc">Next Slide</span> </a> <div class="box1 row1-3"> <a class="image-fade" href="Founder.aspx"> <img alt="Dubli-Network-Founder" src="/Images/Home/founder.jpg"/> </a> <h2>Leadership</h2> <p>The combination of technology and financial expertise offered by the Board of Directors provides a unique foundation of guidance and support to lead Dubli, Inc., into the future. </p> <div class="actions"> <a href="Founder.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div> <div class="box1 row2-2" style="width: 66.6667%;"> <a class="image-fade" href="headquarters.aspx"> <img alt="Dubli-Headquarters" src="/Images/Home/earth2.jpg"/> </a> <h2>Headquarters</h2> <p>Headquartered in Boca Raton, Florida with offices in Berlin, Germany and Dubai, UAE, Dubli, Inc. (OTCQB: DUBL), a publicly-traded U.S. company, is the parent company of both Dubli.com and Dubli Network. Dubli has positioned itself with operations around ...</p> <div class="actions"> <a href="headquarters.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div> <div class="box1 row2-3 last"> <a class="image-fade" href="pressaboutus.aspx"> <img alt="What-the-Press-Is-Saying-About-Dubli" src="/Images/Home/pressaboutus.jpg"/> </a> <h2>What the Press is Saying About Us</h2> <p>In just a few short years Dubli Network has become the largest e-commerce network marketing company.  As such, the press and media outlets from around the world, as well as from sponsorships and charitable activities, have taken notice and...</p> <div class="actions"> <a href="pressaboutus.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div>
</div>
<div class="item" role="document">
<div class="box2 row1-1 first"> <a class="image-fade" href="NetworkOpportunity.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Home/networkopportunity.jpg"/> </a> <div class="inner"> <h1>The Dubli Network Opportunity</h1> <p>Do you find yourself wondering how different your life would be if you could just come up with one new idea or find some need out there that is not being met, then maybe you would have a chance to really cash in for you and your family, changing your life forever?</p> <a href="NetworkOpportunity.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div> <a class="carousel-control left" data-slide="prev" href="#carousel"> <span class="dart"></span><span class="trunc">Previous Slide</span> </a> <a class="carousel-control right" data-slide="next" href="#carousel"> <span class="dart"></span> <span class="trunc">Next Slide</span> </a> <div class="box1 row1-3"> <a class="image-fade" href="makemoney.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Home/makemoney.jpg"/> </a> <h2>How to make money</h2> <p>Dubli Network offers you global potential for earning an exceptional income with one of the most unique and revolutionary compensation plans in the world.</p> <div class="actions"> <a href="makemoney.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div> <div class="box1 row2-1"> <a class="image-fade" href="PartnerProgram.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Home/partnerprogram.jpg"/> </a> <h2>Partner Program</h2> <p>At Dubli, we believe in giving what you'd like to receive back. The Dubli Partner Program is the clear choice for any organization looking to augment their business model with one of the world's most dynamic online Shopping, Travel and Entertainment sites.</p> <div class="actions"> <a href="PartnerProgram.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div> <div class="box1 row2-2"> <a class="image-fade" href="UpcomingEvents.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Home/upcomingevents.jpg"/> </a> <h2>Upcoming events</h2> <p>Dubli Network leaders around the world continually host webinars and live national and local area events. Please check the meeting and events calendar for webinars and live events near you. </p> <div class="actions"> <a href="UpcomingEvents.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div> <div class="box1 row2-3 last"> <a class="image-fade" href="LeaderEvents.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Home/events.jpg"/> </a> <h2>International Leader Events</h2> <p>Twice annually, Dubli Network organizes Leader Events around the world. Past events have been held in Vienna, Austria, Boca Raton, Florida and Dubai, UAE. </p> <div class="actions"> <a href="LeaderEvents.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div>
</div>
<div class="item" role="document">
<div class="box2 row1-1 first"> <a class="image-fade" href="Dublicom.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Home/Dublicashback.jpg" style="width: 800px; height: 380px;"/> </a> <div class="inner"> <h1>Dubli.com</h1> <p>Dubli.com is the most comprehensive Cash Back online shopping destination in the world. The Dubli.com platform is the only e-commerce site to offer Cash Back on shopping and travel combined with additional savings on a global scale.</p> <a href="Dublicom.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div> <a class="carousel-control left" data-slide="prev" href="#carousel"> <span class="dart"></span><span class="trunc">Previous Slide</span> </a> <a class="carousel-control right" data-slide="next" href="#carousel"> <span class="dart"></span> <span class="trunc">Next Slide</span> </a> <div class="box1 row1-3"> <a class="image-fade" href="Dublicom.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Home/viplounge.jpg" style="width: 400px; height: 150px;"/> </a> <h2>Global VIP Rewards</h2> <p>Living in luxury doesn’t come with the price tag when you join as a Dubli’s VIP Rewards member. The VIP Rewards membership is only $49 per year or $4.99 per month and provides thousands of dollars in value with access to exclusive coupons, deals, offers, and increased unlimited Cash Back shopping. Save money on everything from travel bookings, shopping, dining, leisure, and entertainment.</p> </div> <div class="box1 row2-1"> <a class="image-fade" href="Dublicom.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Home/Dublishopping.jpg" style="width: 400px; height: 150px;"/> </a> <h2>GAMIFICATION – ENCOURAGING CUSTOMER LOYALTY</h2> <p>Through ‘Boosted Cash Back’ gamification, Dubli.com rewards Basic customers for repeat shopping, reviews and other value-added engagement. Shoppers may earn up to double the Cash Back, reaching Premier level status, when Boosted Cash Back and Free Cash Back earnings are combined.</p> </div> <div class="box1 row2-2 last"> <a class="image-fade" href="Dublicom.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Home/personalization.jpg" style="width: 400px; height: 150px;"/> </a> <h2>PERSONALIZATION AND UNIQUE CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE </h2> <p>Each time a shopper logs in, shops, searches, clicks or performs any activity on the site, the Dubli platform will record this information and tailor future logins and recommendations based on the individual customer’s interests. These “collections” will provide a unique customer experience. In the simplest terms, each Dubli.com shopper will receive their own customized shopping experience.</p> </div> <div class="box1 row2-3"> <a class="image-fade" href="Dublicom.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Home/maximize_savings.jpg" style="width: 400px; height: 150px;"/> </a> <h2>MAXIMIZING SAVINGS WITH Dubli.com</h2> <p>Savings shouldn’t stop once a consumer finds the best online deal or coupon. The Dubli site allows shoppers to stack coupons and deals with Cash Back so they can double or triple their savings on every purchase. Dubli calls this unique savings proposition “Stackable Savings” because through Dubli.com, customers can save multiple times on one single purchase.</p> </div>
</div>
<div class="item" role="document">
<div class="box2 row1-1 first"> <a class="image-fade" href="NetworkNews.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Dummy/box-800-large.jpg"/> </a> <div class="inner"> <h1>Dubli Network News</h1> <p>There are always new exciting developments going on at Dubli Network.  Please use this page as your destination for all news, developments, product launches and new Dubli Network tools.  Check out the latest press release, see what’s happening throughout Dubli around the world and learn more about what the press is saying about us.  We welcome you to the wonderful world of Dubli.</p> <div class="actions"> <a href="NetworkNews.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div> </div> <a class="carousel-control left" data-slide="prev" href="#carousel"> <span class="dart"></span> <span class="trunc">Previous Slide</span> </a> <a class="carousel-control right" data-slide="next" href="#carousel"> <span class="dart"></span> <span class="trunc">Next Slide</span> </a> <div class="box1 row1-3"> <a class="image-fade" href="Dublicomnews.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Dummy/box-400-2.jpg"/> </a> <h2>Dubli.com News</h2> <p>Find all the latest product developments, shopping mall updates, new travel services and enhancements to the Dubli.com website.  With its unique value proposition, Dubli.com has earned the attention of the media around the globe. This is your source for all things Dubli.com around the world.</p> <div class="actions"> <a href="Dublicomnews.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div> <div class="box1 row2-1"> <a class="image-fade" href="Dubliincnews.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Dummy/box-400-1.jpg"/> </a> <h2>Dubli Inc. News</h2> <p>As the parent company of both Dubli Network and Dubli.com and the publicly-traded entity, Dubli, Inc. is frequently publishing news and developments.  Here you will find the latest corporate news and updates, press releases and articles and news written by the global press.  </p> <div class="actions"> <a href="Dubliincnews.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div> <div class="box1 row2-2"> <a class="image-fade" href="Dublitv.aspx"> <img alt="" src="/Images/Dummy/box-400-3.jpg"/> </a> <h2>Dubli TV Updates</h2> <p>Dubli TV is the online TV network for Dubli Network, the world’s largest direct selling e-commerce company. Dubli TV serves as a one-stop source for the latest information, inspiration, recognition, and motivation in multiple languages for Business Associates (BAs) and Dubli customers around the world.</p> <div class="actions"> <a href="/en/News/DubliTV.aspx">» Dubli TV Updates</a> </div> </div> <div class="box1 row2-3 last"> <a class="image-fade" href="testimonials.aspx"> <img alt="" src="./../Images/Dummy/box-400-4.jpg"/> </a> <h2>Testimonials</h2> <p>Want to know what Dubli Network’s leaders around the world are doing?  Find out their key strategies, useful tools and how they have grown their Dubli Network business.  Read about why our leaders are part of Dubli Network, their perspective on the future and how to continue to cultivate and motivate their organizations.</p> <div class="actions"> <a href="testimonials.aspx">» Read more</a> </div> </div>
</div>
